newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds ease, focus on auction.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds ease, focus on auction.

text.p: Portuguese bonds recovered from the lows at the close in a calm session and dealers said investors were focusing on tomorrow's decision by the Bank of Spain on the repo rate and a five-year Portuguese bond auction.
"The September future and cash recovered at the close, but spreads against Germany and Spain were steady around the levels of Friday's close," said one dealer.
Another said: "The market is awaiting the Bank of Spain's rate decision tomorrow, which will have a strong impact on short term Portuguese rates and rates at the five-year Portuguese bond auction."
